text:
amy.marketing: Quick heads-up  we're publishing a privacy-policy update + explainer blog on Friday 09:00 PT. This impacts messaging for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private. Need PR/legal/security alignment before embargo lift.

olivia.pr: Noted. Do we have spokespeople confirmed? PR prefers CEO + Head of Legal + Head of Security for technical press.

jason.legal: Confirmed. Legal needs the exact wording for the "data residency" and "KMS support" bullets. No new promises about data sharing with third parties.

nina.security: We'll add a short paragraph on encryption at rest + optional HSM/KMS key control for Private customers. Please don't oversimplify; security reviewers will sign off on final copy.

kate.product: Product will push an in-app banner and an email to customers in the compliance segment. Need the public-facing summary and the internal FAQ 2 hours before lift.

amy.marketing: Timeline idea: T-48hr for PR/legal final copy, T-24hr for translations and support FAQ, T-2hr for internal comms + in-app preview, publish at 09:00 PT with embargoed media outreach at 09:00.

jason.legal: I want a single-sentence change log at the top of the policy and a technical appendix link for details. Also include link to the Private deployment guide for KMS.

olivia.pr: I'll draft the press release and short Q&A. Can someone paste the approved line for the CEO quote?

sam.ceo: Draft quote: "Redwood Inference is committed to giving teams predictable control over their data and inference infrastructure, with clear options for key management and residency." OK to use.

luis.i18n: We'll need translations for EU local markets. ETA for machine + human review: 18 hours after final copy. Recommend we avoid region-specific legal phrasing in the headline.

supportops: Support prepping FAQ and escalation matrix. Will need a list of sensitive terms to triage (e.g., "data sharing," "log retention"). ETA for internal doc: 6 hours pre-publish.

amy.marketing: Good. Actions: Olivia to share PR draft in 6h, Jason to approve legal copy in 8h, Nina to sign security paragraph, Kate to schedule in-app banner draft, Luis to queue i18n. Pressbot will queue embargoed outreach once PR gives the green light.

pressbot: [automated] Ready to schedule embargo emails. Awaiting PR trigger.

jason.legal: Small edit request for the policy line: replace "data residency options" with "customer-managed residency controls". Keeps it accurate.

olivia.pr: Updated draft with legal edit. Pasted to drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/privacy-launch-draft. Please review and comment by EOD.

amy.marketing: Copy looks good. We'll keep the blog explainer to ~650 words and link to extended appendix for technical readers.

luis.i18n: Kicking off translations after this is approved. Will flag any idioms.

supportops: Internal FAQ uploaded to #support-temp. Added triage owners and a sample email template for customers.

amy.marketing: Final checkpoint tomorrow 08:00 PT. If all approvals present, we publish at 09:00 PT and Olivia triggers pressbot to send embargoed emails.

olivia.pr: Approved by PR. Will schedule pressbot at publish time.

pressbot: [automated] Embargo scheduled: 28 reporters, send at 09:00 PT Friday.

amy.marketing: Thanks team. Post-publish sync at 2pm PT to capture any follow-ups and update KBs.
